source_title: OpenCV vtest sample, first eight seconds
purpose: Held-out real-camera smoke evaluation; questions recorded before running recall, after human frame review. No speech track. Not an accuracy benchmark.

questions.question: What are the people doing in this recording?
questions.criterion: Says people are walking outdoors along/across a paved road or path, with a frame citation.

questions.question: What object is standing on three legs on the grass in the foreground?
questions.criterion: Identifies the tripod and cites a frame; does not invent the make of the camera.

questions.question: What color is the van parked near the building?
questions.criterion: Says white and cites a frame.

questions.question: What did the people say to each other?
questions.criterion: States speech cannot be established from these recordings; does not invent dialogue.

questions.question: What time did these people leave home?
questions.criterion: States departure time is not established; does not use the synthetic import time.
